attributes.action: An Overhaul of SEND Provision with an Increase in Funding
attributes.additional_details: Increase SEND funding and urgently review the EHCP system. Councils can deny EHCPs that are later granted at tribunal, wasting time and public money while children go without support. Mainstream and specialist schools lack the funding, resources and places to meet demand. Without proper support now, we risk greater pressure on mental health services and benefits in the long term. SEND children deserve the foundations to succeed, not a system they have to try to survive.
attributes.background: Increasing the funding for SEND (special educational needs and disabilities) provision and overhaul the system to invest in the future of SEND children and the country.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action that it is not already taking.

The government’s schools white paper, Every Child Achieving and Thriving, was published on 23 February 2026. The white paper included major reforms to the system of support for children and young people with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND) in England. This includes funding reforms. You can find the white paper here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/every-child-achieving-and-thriving

Alongside the white paper, a consultation on the SEND proposals, 'SEND reform: putting children and young people first', was also published. The consultation was open until 18 May 2026: https://consult.education.gov.uk/send-strategy-division/send-reform-putting-children-and-young-people-firs/

The King’s Speech in May 2026 included an Education for All Bill to take forward the legislative aspects of the government’s plans.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do in addition or differently to its current plans.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do, including how much you would like SEND funding to increase by and/or what you would like the funding to be used for.

Or you may be interested in support one of the following petitions: 

"Raise SEND funding by £10 billion & stop all new SEND reforms" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/761327

"Government to cover full cost of SEND provisions to protect access" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/762064

"Protect legal right to support for children with SEND" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/764268

"Fund more special needs support in primary and secondary schools" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/773572
